def test_composite_interaction_current_population_is_admitted_at_registered_objective() -> None: registry = PluginRegistry() registry.clear() plugin = EconomicsPlugin() registry.register(plugin) state = EconomicState.empty(n_agents=12, seed=7) state = state.replace(agents=state.agents.replace(wealth=jnp.asarray([2.0, 1.0] * 6))) interaction = CrossDomainInteraction( source_domain="economics", target_domain="economics", source_field="agents.wealth", target_field="agents.wealth", transform=lambda values: values * jnp.asarray([-1.0, 1.0] * 6), ) config = CompositeStateConfig( domains={"economics": DomainConfig(n_agents=12, enabled_mechanisms=("taxation",))}, interactions=[interaction], ) composite = CompositeState( domain_states={"economics": state}, time_step=jnp.asarray(0), config=config ) after = CompositeExecutor(["economics"], registry).step(composite, jax.random.PRNGKey(3)) current = after.get_domain("economics") np.testing.assert_array_equal(current.agents.wealth, [-2.0, 1.0] * 6) assert np.isfinite(float(current.distributions.gini_wealth)) with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="classical Gini requires finite nonnegative"): > jax.block_until_ready(plugin.get_objectives()["gini"].evaluate(current)) ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
